name: stationary_feedback_analysis01
purpose: Analytical hypothesis check only. Not a flight, model evaluation, acceptance gate, or registered training recipe.
source_observation: stress_train15_en_stationary_snapshot_10.json: sustained attitude-estimation offsets and small teacher-imitation error during unsuccessful stationary flight.
scope: One-axis linear surrogate with attitude lag, sampled delayed requests and constant attitude-estimation disturbance. It cannot establish actual MuJoCo or hardware performance.

equations.attitude_input_mapping: estimated_acceleration = -g*tan(pitch) for forward, -g*tan(roll) for left; small-angle command proxy, no truth input needed by teacher formula

report: last ten seconds speed RMS and maximum
limitations: no camera, VLA, EKF, noise, rotation, vertical flight or battery
does not replace existing flight score
no new runtime gains or code
no model training or checkpoint selection
